attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Wounded warriors, whether still in service or discharged, deserve the best medical care the country can provide.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The nature of the fighting in Iraq and Afghanistan has resulted in an unprecedented incidence of traumatic brain injury, loss of limbs, and post-traumatic stress disorder.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A new commitment of resources and personnel is needed for the treatment and care of traumatic brain injury, loss of limbs, and post-traumatic stress disorder to promote recovery.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Military and veterans' medicine should be the gold standard for mental health care, advances in prosthetics, and treatment of trauma and eye injuries.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Meaningful financial assistance should be assured to the families of those who have made the ultimate sacrifice.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Today's veterans face new challenges because the conditions of warfare have changed dramatically since the war on terror began.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Asymmetrical or non-traditional warfare results in a high incidence of severe conditions that must receive high priority.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Continued research into prevention and treatment of severe conditions is needed.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
